author: NorthEast News Desk
body: The Tampa Bay Rays and Milwaukee Brewers became the first Major League Baseball teams to secure 2026 postseason places Friday, clinching in dramatically different fashion. Tampa Bay beat Houston 3-1 on Junior Caminero’s walk-off home run, while Milwaukee overwhelmed Cincinnati 20-0.

Caminero drove a 417-foot homer off Bryan Abreu for his 40th of the season, turning a tie game into a celebration at Tropicana Field. The win guaranteed the Rays a playoff berth with the regular season entering its final stretch. Tampa Bay’s pitching held Houston to one run before the ninth-inning finish.

Milwaukee left little doubt in its clincher. Garrett Mitchell hit a grand slam, William Contreras homered and drove in six runs, and Dustin May allowed two hits over six scoreless innings. The Brewers earned their eighth postseason appearance in nine seasons. With both clubs officially through, attention now shifts to division positioning and the remaining wild-card races as the rest of the field takes shape.
dek: Tampa Bay advanced on Junior Caminero’s walk-off homer, while Milwaukee secured its place with a 20-run rout of Cincinnati.
headline: Rays and Brewers become first teams to clinch MLB playoff berths
